''See also: [[Weeping Dragon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] is one of the four [[Dreadgods]], a class of immensely powerful entities. Unlike its siblings, this [[dragon]] retains memories of its former life and possesses a sense of superiority and pride. It typically resides in the upper atmosphere, resting upon a massive bed of clouds. While it is capable of high-level thought, it has spent centuries in a state that is more beast than sentient being, often dreaming of its past and weeping for what it has lost. It is also noted that the [[dragon]]'s presence can cause significant environmental changes, such as inducing rain or causing landslides. The Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] is associated with storms, lightning, and [[wind]]. Its power manifests through blue-and-gold [[lightning madra]] and the ability to command storms that follow its flight. A primary method of feeding involves releasing millions of small, serpentine [[dragon]] spirits made of [[Storm madra{{!}}storm madra]]; these creatures act like locusts, consuming the spiritual energy of targets to return it to the [[Dreadgod]]. Its combat abilities include a devastating [[black dragon's breath{{!}}dragon's breath]] and the capacity to manipulate gravity or command others with its voice. A dedicated cult known as the [[Stormcallers]] follows the Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]]. Members of this sect often utilize [[madra]] derived from the [[dragon]] itself, which carries its animating will and [[hunger]]. The [[Stormcallers]] are known for their ability to summon [[living lightning]] and have been involved in significant conflicts, including the [[destruction]] of various sects and defenses. The [[dragon]]'s history is also linked to a major battle involving the [[Monarch]] [[Northstrider]], who was severely wounded by its lightning.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] is a [[sapphire]]-colored [[dragon]] measuring miles in length. It is surrounded by crackling lightning and possesses blue [[scales]], a claw that trails lightning, and a [[core binding]] shaped like a golden jewel as long as an arm.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This clever entity acts like a rampaging monster and possesses an unbending [[dragon]]'s pride. Its will is as fierce as a storm, and it [[dreams]] of the past while fearing its own awakening.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] fought [[Northstrider]] and attacked the sect of [[Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel]], who is preparing to fight it. It has targeted [[Yerin]] and left wreckage at the home of [[Luminous Queen Sha Miara{{!}}Sha Miara]], while [[Lindon]], [[Orthos]], [[Little Blue]], and [[Calan Archer{{!}}Calan]] are connected to the entity. Additionally, [[Malice]] hopes [[Lindon]] will serve as food for the [[dragon]], and it is expected to perform a task for [[Reigan Shen]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The creature utilizes [[living lightning]] and [[Striker techniques]] that manifest as tiny serpentine [[dragons]] of blue-gold [[Storm madra{{!}}storm madra]]. Its most powerful offensive [[technique]] is a [[black dragon's breath{{!}}dragon's breath]] involving blue-and-[[yellow madra]] that devours [[aura]] and cannot be defended against. The entity can also cloud possibilities, dodge predictions, and use an [[Authority{{!}}authority]] that can crush spirits.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] is a battle occurring on the [[Rosegold continent]] involving a clever entity that acts like a rampaging monster.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref> Gaining strength from the demise of the [[Silent King]] and the [[Slumbering Wraith]], this creature possesses the exterior of a [[Wandering Titan]] but contains the [[Silent King]] within.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /> This [[Dreadgod]] can dodge predictions by clouding possibilities and carries hidden threads of [[Fate]] behind clouds.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> The entity's breath is the strongest offensive [[technique]] on the planet, utilizing blue-and-[[yellow madra]] to devour [[aura]] in a way that can only be evaded rather than defended against.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> During a clash against [[Lindon]], who was supported by [[Little Blue]] and [[Orthos]], the creature commanded the [[Penance arrow]] away.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> Possessing an unbending [[dragon]]'s pride, the Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] drags dark clouds wherever it goes and thrashes across the landscape like a dying snake.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> Its presence causes rain and storm clouds, while its fierce, [[dragon]]-like will can cause [[wind]] and lightning storms when its eyes focus on [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> The creature's gaze can strip away hope and crush spirits, much like its [[Authority{{!}}authority]] which can crush [[Yerin]] or its lightning-trailing claw.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] drags dark clouds around everywhere.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] is thrashing around the landscape like a dying snake.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]]'s presence causes storm clouds and rain.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]]'s eyes focus on [[Yerin]] and its rage causes [[wind]] and lightning storms.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] has a claw that trails lightning.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]]'s [[Authority{{!}}authority]] can crush [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]]'s will is described as fierce as a storm and imposing as the greatest of [[dragons]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Waybound}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Dreadgod]] known as the Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] eventually died.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> This [[Dreadgod]] was defeated in battle and possessed a [[core binding]] consisting of a golden jewel as long as [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm{{!}}Lindon's arm]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> During the conflict, the Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] used the full force of its will to intentionally injure [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] was a [[Dreadgod]] that was defeated in battle.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] attacked [[Yerin]] with the full force of its will to cause her injuries intentionally.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]]'s [[core binding]] is a golden jewel as long as [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm{{!}}Lindon's arm]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] has a [[core binding]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Waybound}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] is a battle that [[Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss]] may have sensed, though information regarding the entity remains limited.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref> It is theoretically possible to develop a method of transportation using the creature's [[madra]], which possesses enough power that an Overlord-level entity could nearly handle a portion of it.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32">''Waybound'', chapter 32</ref> As its breath began to form, the entity was mentioned by [[Lindon]] in relation to [[Del'rek{{!}}Del’rek]]'s [[Path]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref> The breath of the Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] eventually slashed across the face of a moon.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] is a battle [[Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss]] may have sensed.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Information on the [[Weeping Dragon]] is limited.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|It is theoretically possible to create a method of transportation from the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]]'s breath began to form.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] has [[madra]] that an Overlord-level entity can almost handle a portion of.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] mentions the [[Weeping Dragon]] in relation to [[Del'rek{{!}}Del’rek]]'s [[Path]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]]'s breath slashed across the face of a moon.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Tidewalkers]] suffered great devastation at the hands of the Weeping [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 1</ref> This entity also left a lasting scar across the surface of the moon.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> Later, [[Lindon]] was enveloped in a lightning-crackling embrace by the creature's blue [[scales]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref>}}

<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon]] left a scar across the face of the moon.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“Pardon, but the Weeping Dragon isn’t coming here. It’s headed wherever I am, and I don’t intend to be here.”<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“I will swear to duel you,” he said at last. “But we fight to death, surrender, or the arrival of the Weeping Dragon.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11" />}}
